title: Adopt structured hiring scorecards
description: Replace ad-hoc interviewing with role-based scorecards and calibrated rubrics to reduce hiring variance.

title: Refresh employer brand narrative
description: Articulate a differentiated EVP and align careers site, recruiters, and onboarding messaging.

title: Run quarterly stay interviews with critical talent
description: Proactively probe motivators and friction points before attrition signals appear.

title: Introduce performance calibration sessions
description: Cross-team calibration removes manager bias and standardises rating distributions.

title: Shift from annual reviews to continuous feedback
description: Replace annual reviews with quarterly check-ins supported by lightweight tooling.

title: Cascade OKRs to every team
description: Tie individual goals to company OKRs to drive alignment and outcome-focus.

title: Stand up a unified skills taxonomy
description: Build a shared skills ontology to power capability assessments, learning, and mobility.

title: Invest in manager capability programmes
description: Frontline managers are the single biggest driver of engagement - invest in coaching, feedback, and difficult conversations.

title: Curate upskilling pathways for critical roles
description: Pre-curated learning journeys for the 5-10 most critical role families.

title: Build AI literacy across the workforce
description: Run an enterprise-wide AI fluency programme so adoption scales beyond early experimenters.

title: De-layer the organisation
description: Remove unnecessary management layers to speed decisions and clarify accountability.

title: Right-size manager spans of control
description: Audit team sizes and rebalance to target span-of-control bands.

title: Codify operating rhythms and decision rights
description: Make meetings, decisions, and escalation paths explicit to reduce friction.

title: Pilot cross-functional pods for priority initiatives
description: Stand up small empowered teams for the top 3 strategic bets.

title: Build successor pools for the top 20 critical roles
description: Identify ready-now and ready-next successors for the most business-critical positions.

title: Run an executive alignment offsite
description: Realign the leadership team around shared priorities and target operating model.

title: Provide executive coaching to the top team
description: 1:1 coaching for senior leaders, paired with 360 feedback.

title: Launch a future-leaders accelerator
description: Develop the next layer of leaders via structured 12-month cohort programme.

title: Refresh and operationalise the values
description: Translate aspirational values into observable behaviours, embedded in hiring, performance, and recognition.

title: Launch a peer recognition programme
description: Lightweight kudos system tied to company values, surfaced in team rituals.

title: Move to continuous engagement listening
description: Replace annual surveys with quarterly pulses and always-on listening posts.

title: Embed DEI in hiring and promotion processes
description: Diverse slates, structured panels, and adverse-impact tracking across hiring and promotion gates.

title: Run a market-pay calibration cycle
description: Refresh salary bands against current market and address compression risks.

title: Publish pay bands internally
description: Increase transparency on salary bands and progression criteria to reduce attrition driven by inequity perception.

title: Introduce LTIP for critical talent
description: Long-term incentive plans tied to retention for top performers and critical-skill roles.

title: Refresh total rewards philosophy and mix
description: Re-articulate the philosophy, mix, and segmentation across pay, benefits, and recognition.

title: Build a 3-year workforce demand - supply model
description: Quantify role-family demand against attrition + supply forecasts to surface critical gaps.

title: Run quarterly workforce scenario simulations
description: Standing cadence of what-if runs (growth, restructure, automation) to inform exec decisions.

title: Re-evaluate location & hub strategy
description: Anchor talent strategy to a defined set of hubs/regions matched to role-family supply.

title: Define an integrated contingent workforce strategy
description: Treat contractors / freelancers / vendors as part of the total workforce model.

title: Adopt an internal-first hiring policy
description: Post all open roles internally first; track internal fill-rate as an executive KPI.

title: Launch a structured rotation programme
description: 12-18 month rotations across functions to build versatile leaders and break silos.
